dogecoin.text: Musk's behavior is a microcosm of everything that's wrong with American capitalism. From GameStop stock to Dogecoin, Musk has learned how to use how stardom to manipulate markets and make billions for himself. It's an example that shows this country's total lack of regulations.
My investment strategy has shifted from being sensible to following Elon Musk on Twitter to see what shitty cryptocurrency he starts tweeting about after Dogecoin crashes.
If the moon is up Elon Musk's ass, then dogecoin finally went there.
